existing_store_signal: `blocks.attributes` Map changes on `UPDATE_BLOCK_ATTRIBUTES`; `lastBlockAttributesChange` records the latest changed ids and attributes.
signal_scope: client attribute state plus latest action
why_it_is_not_enough_by_itself: `lastBlockAttributesChange` is only the latest attribute action and resets for non-attribute actions; the attributes Map has no exposed per-clientId version and reading it through `useSelect` still wakes every subscriber.
required_prototype_signal: private per-clientId own-attributes revision, with latest-attribute-action fast path only as an optimization

existing_store_signal: `blocks.byClientId` and `blocks.tree` change on `UPDATE_BLOCK`, insert, replace, remove, and reset paths.
why_it_is_not_enough_by_itself: Existing selectors return values, not a stable identity-version key for unrelated blocks; replacement/removal also has to invalidate descendants and public filter props.
required_prototype_signal: per-clientId identity/tree revision, including replacement/removal invalidation

existing_store_signal: `selection`, `initialPosition`, `highlightedBlock`, `draggedBlocks`, spotlight/overlay-related state, and selection-enabled state change on their own action families.
why_it_is_not_enough_by_itself: Provider needs to invalidate selected blocks, ancestors of selected blocks, dragged/highlighted/overlay participants, and sometimes roots; there is no single existing selector that returns that affected set as a version.

existing_store_signal: `blocks.order`, `blocks.parents`, and `blocks.tree` change on insert, move, replace, remove, reset, and controlled-inner-block paths.
why_it_is_not_enough_by_itself: Provider needs per-root structure invalidation plus section-parent and duplicate-block-name invalidation; the existing maps are internal and not packaged as a cheap dependency key.
required_prototype_signal: root structural revision plus affected parent/section roots

existing_store_signal: `blocks.blockEditingModes`, `derivedBlockEditingModes`, `blockListSettings`, `settings`, `blockVisibility`, and permission/capability selectors cover pieces of the result.
signal_scope: mixed client, root, and global state
why_it_is_not_enough_by_itself: The provider output combines client mode, root mode, template lock, edited content-only section, visibility, device, preview, and binding settings; no existing signal captures that combined invalidation safely.
required_prototype_signal: separate editability/capability/settings/device revisions, or keep this part in the selectedProps selector until proven stable

existing_store_signal: `isZoomOut()` and `getSectionRootClientId()` read zoom level and section-root settings.
why_it_is_not_enough_by_itself: This boundary is small and could be recomputed directly, but it still lacks a named revision key for ordinary text-update skip decisions.
required_prototype_signal: zoom/section-root revision or direct read in a small root-only selector

existing_store_signal: `getBlockName`, `getBlockRootClientId`, `getBlockType`, and block support selectors cover the needed values.
why_it_is_not_enough_by_itself: Block replacement, transform, parent/root move, and block-type/support registration need to invalidate; existing selectors do not provide a cheap dependency key independent of recomputing the selector.
required_prototype_signal: client identity/root revision plus block-type/support revision

existing_store_signal: `getBlockSettings( clientId, 'layout' )` reads current or ancestor attributes, global settings, and runtime filters.
signal_scope: client/ancestor attributes plus settings plus filters
why_it_is_not_enough_by_itself: An attributes-blind skip is unsafe because ancestor layout/settings attributes can change the child's default layout; filters also make a purely reducer-owned version incomplete.
required_prototype_signal: layout-settings dependency key covering current block, ancestors, global settings, and filter invalidation policy

why_it_is_not_enough_by_itself: The values are available, but not as a single skip key; parent template lock and derived editing modes need parent/root invalidation.
required_prototype_signal: editability/template/zoom revision keyed by client and parent root
